title: [smartswitch]: Fix IndexError in dpuhosts access for DPU platform tests
author: vvolam
body:
## Description

Multiple DPU platform tests crash with `IndexError: list index out of range` when the testbed defines fewer DPU SSH hosts than the platform has DPU module slots (e.g., `dpuhosts` has 1 node but the platform reports DPU0–DPU3).

## Root Cause

Direct `dpuhosts[index]` or `dpuhosts[dpu_id]` accesses assume a 1:1 mapping between platform module index and `dpuhosts` list position. When the testbed inventory only includes a subset of DPUs, this causes an `IndexError`.

The `get_dpuhost_for_dpu()` helper (formerly `_get_dpuhost_for_dpu()`) in `device_utils_dpu.py` was introduced to handle this safely, but was not used in all call sites.

## Affected Tests

- `test_npu_dpu_date`
- `test_dpu_memory`
- `test_system_health_summary`
- `test_watchdog_status_check`
- `test_dpu_status_post_dpu_kernel_panic`
- `test_dpu_check_post_dpu_mem_exhaustion`

## Fix

Replace all remaining direct `dpuhosts[index/dpu_id]` accesses with `get_dpuhost_for_dpu()`, which does bounds checking, hostname-based fallback lookup, and graceful skip when the DPU is not in the testbed inventory.

Also renamed `_get_dpuhost_for_dpu` → `get_dpuhost_for_dpu` since it is used across multiple modules.

## Files Changed

- `tests/smartswitch/common/device_utils_dpu.py`
- `tests/smartswitch/platform_tests/test_platform_dpu.py`
- `tests/smartswitch/platform_tests/test_reload_dpu.py`
